title: Circuit Component Library Test
description: Test demonstration of the p5.js circuit component drawing library with functions for resistors, capacitors, inductors, batteries, and switches
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Circuit Components
Drawing Library
p5.js
Electronic Symbols
Circuit Diagrams
learningObjectives: Identify the standard schematic symbols for resistors, capacitors, inductors, batteries, and switches by their distinguishing shapes
Explain how a reusable p5.js drawing library separates component geometry from circuit layout so symbols can be reused across sketches
Trace how position, size, line width, orientation, and label parameters passed to drawResistor() or drawCapacitor() change the rendered symbol
Compare the horizontal and vertical rendering of each component and explain why orientation must not alter the symbol's meaning
Design a new component drawing function that follows the library's existing parameter conventions
